title: Locked confirmatory test of the validation-selected retrieval baseline
researchQuestion: Does the validation-selected single-pass retrieval configuration retain strong canonical-evidence retrieval and controlled abstention on a larger, newly authored and author-confirmed test set?
hypothesis: The selected baseline generalizes to the 48-case confirmatory benchmark with Recall@4 of at least 0.9167, MRR and nDCG@4 of at least 0.85, and no more than two false positives among 24 unanswerable cases.

testSplit.name: test
testSplit.executionPolicy: Execute exactly once after the benchmark, protocol, and runner are committed. Cache-preserving recovery is allowed only after a technical failure before aggregate metrics are revealed.

approvalProvenance.interpretation: All 48 labels were confirmed case by case by the thesis author. This is a single-reviewer benchmark, not an independent multi-rater gold standard.

metrics.uncertainty: Report Wilson 95% intervals for full-coverage, any-hit, and unanswerable false-positive proportions.

frozenReplicationChecks.interpretation: These are preregistered guardrails, not tuning targets. Failure does not authorize parameter changes or a rerun.

prohibitedAfterExecution: changing chunks, embedding model, metadata filter, reranker, or agentic setting
excluding cases because of their outcomes
rewriting expected facts or evidence after seeing retrieval results
rerunning a completed test to obtain better metrics
limitations: The benchmark was reviewed by one thesis-author reviewer and does not estimate inter-rater reliability.
This test verifies retrieval only; answer-generation quality is evaluated separately.
The corpus and validation-selected configuration are frozen at the recorded July 2026 snapshot.
